overview: The Medford City Council received an update from city officials regarding COVID-19 preparedness, acted on several proposed ordinance and rule amendments, approved small grants and municipal appropriations, and heard public comments on public access television operations.

items.title: Update on COVID-19 Administrative Precautions
items.summary: City health and administrative officials updated the council on local COVID-19 response measures, departmental continuity planning, and first responder protocols.

items.title: Ordinance Amendment on Non-Union Personnel Positions
items.summary: The council approved on first reading an ordinance amendment adding the positions of Director of Communications and Director of Community Affairs to the non-union classification plan.

items.title: Waste Management Contract and Condominium Services
items.summary: The council approved an amended resolution requesting the mayor consider options to include condominium associations in city trash and bulk waste collection.

items.title: Appropriation for Assessor Data Valuations
items.summary: The council approved a free cash appropriation of $47,400 to fund software, valuation services, and updated GIS maps for the Assessor's Office.

items.title: CPA Grant for Dugger Park Benches
items.summary: The council approved a $3,000 Community Preservation Act grant for student leaders to paint and install themed benches at Dugger Park.

items.title: Special Permit Hearing for 33B Mystic Avenue
items.summary: The council voted to table the public hearing for used auto sales and auto repair special permits at 33B Mystic Avenue to the next meeting.

items.title: OPEB Board Retiree Nomination Deadline
items.summary: The council passed an amended resolution requesting the city notify retirees by mail regarding the nomination deadline for the elected retiree seat on the OPEB Board of Trustees.

items.title: Council Rule 37 Amendment on Papers Under Suspension
items.summary: The council voted to refer a proposed amendment restricting papers introduced under suspension to the city solicitor for legal review.

items.title: Ordinance Establishing Extended Illness Leave Bank
items.summary: A proposed ordinance establishing an extended illness leave bank for city and school employees was referred to a Committee of the Whole meeting.

items.title: Council Rule 18 Amendment Defining Petitions and Orders
items.summary: The council approved a rule change defining orders, resolutions, and petitions, while referring general public participation procedures to a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Condolences to the Family of Priscilla Morse
items.summary: The council passed a resolution offering condolences to the family of Priscilla Morse.

items.title: Ordinance Establishing Municipal Minimum Wage
items.summary: The council referred a proposed ordinance setting a minimum wage of $15 per hour for city and school district employees to the city solicitor for legal review.

items.title: Zoning Amendment on Front Yard Parking
items.summary: A proposed zoning ordinance to allow front yard parking when on-street parking is removed was withdrawn by the sponsor following council discussion.

items.title: Common Victualler License for Casa Pizza
items.summary: The council approved a common victualler license application for Casa Pizza at 62 Lambert Street.

items.title: Subcommittee Request for Marijuana Draft Ordinance
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting the Zoning Subcommittee convene to finalize draft ordinances for medical and adult use marijuana.

items.title: Condolences to the Family of Tony Anzalone
items.summary: The council passed a resolution extending condolences to the family of long-time barber and volunteer Tony Anzalone.

items.title: Crosswalk Request for Salem and Everett Streets
items.summary: A resident request for crosswalk installations at the intersection of Salem Street and Everett Street was referred to the Traffic Commission.

items.title: Public Access Television Station Discussion
items.summary: The council voted to receive and place on file a petition regarding public access television management and facility location following public testimony.

items.title: Committee Report on CPA Funding
items.summary: The council approved the February 18, 2020 Committee of the Whole report regarding Community Preservation Act funding requests.

items.title: DCR Notice on Clippership Connector Easement
items.summary: The council announced a notice from the Department of Conservation and Recreation regarding a planned property easement acquisition at 99 Riverside Avenue for the Clippership Connector path.
